title: A form checker
hints: Check `username.length` first and give the length message when it is wrong. Then loop over the characters with `for (const c of username)`: a character is allowed when it is a letter (`c.toLowerCase() >= "a" && c.toLowerCase() <= "z"`), a digit (`c >= "0" && c <= "9"`) or `"_"`; give another message for anything else. The same digit test tells you whether the password has a number.
requirements: Username: 3 to 16 letters, digits or `_`. Password: at least 6 characters and a digit. Confirm: equal to the password.
Return an object with one message per field that has a problem.
Write `fieldsFrom(entries)` that turns `[["username", "ada"], ...]` (what `new FormData(form)` gives) into an object.
stretch: In a page, call `check` on every `input` event and show each message in a `<small>` under its field.
